name: m10-smoke
description: Milestones 9 and 10 smoke, restarted on the explicit mode profiles (2026-11-10, borg-zoo#54): M10 against M9 under the product default (munchkin-class), and the modes against each other on each milestone. The original run compared 4.2.6 against M9/M10 on default, which straddled the mode cutoff - better-borg-c fd683ced (PR 302) makes borg_munchkin_by_class default TRUE on M9/M10 but does not exist on 4.2.6 - so those comparisons are excluded; the original-vs-milestone question now belongs to the pre-cutoff history, and the current baseline is 4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661 (bbc-explicit-smoke).
